greeting: Jazz. Just Jazz. Like the music.
Cool breeze up here. Cool tunes too.
You look like you need a melody.
The mountain's got rhythm. I provide the soul.
Flute's my voice. Mountains my stage.
dialog.shop_open: I sell tunes. Lessons. Good vibes.
dialog.shop_prompt: Sheet music. Flute techniques. Chill encouragement.
haggle: For a fellow lover of sound? Deal.
purchase_success: Spread the sound. Share the peace.
purchase_fail: Come back when the rhythm moves you.
rumor: Hashimoto's got no rhythm. Tried to teach him. Failed. Still cool though.
The twins? Perfect harmony. Natural syncopation.
That black coat plays a different tune. Minor key. Real minor.
Heard there's a snake charmer in Dustbelt. Different style. Respect.
dialog.quest_hook: Lost my favorite reed. Special bamboo. Only grows in the Whispering Grove. Wind spirits guard it. Retrieve it? I'll compose your theme song.
dialog.quest_active: Whispering Grove. Listen for the music. The reeds sing. Wind spirits dance. Careful.
dialog.quest_complete: My reed! Listen to this tone! Pure! Here's your theme. Play it when you triumph. Epic stuff.
dialog.quest_reward: Hero's Theme Song - Morale boost ability
dialog.time_noon: High noon jazz. Bright notes. Sharp contrasts.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The reed-finder. Hero with a theme now.

party_reactions.kade: You're very... cool. I feel underdressed.
party_reactions.nix7: Auditory patterns: pleasing. Functional purpose: unclear.
party_reactions.twist: Play something FAST! I want to DANCE!
party_reactions.renna: Is that jazz I hear? Or just you?

mini_quest.title: The Lost Reed
mini_quest.description: Retrieve special bamboo reed from the Whispering Grove

stages.hook: Lost my favorite reed. Special bamboo. Only in Whispering Grove. Wind spirits guard it. Retrieve? I'll compose your theme song.
stages.active: Whispering Grove. Listen for the music. Reeds sing there. Wind spirits dance. Careful - they bite if you step on the rhythm.
stages.complete: My reed! Hear this tone! Pure! Here's your theme. Play it when you triumph. Epic. Grammy-worthy. If they had Grammys here.
